papers.s2: The paper has the right shape: lessons 4-6 carry most of it and lessons 1-3 take about a quarter, with all five skills present. Listening and vocabulary are too easy, because the hear options are unrelated in meaning and some fill distractors are numbers. The real damage is reuse: the reading texts (Q33, Q39-42) print sentences that grammar, fill, order and hand-writing then test (Q20, Q28, Q37, Q44-46, Q48), and Q27/Q28 test 有点儿 twice with the same options.
papers.mid2: Lessons 9-15 are covered fairly evenly, with lesson 9 a little heavy. Item by item it reads like a real exam, but as a whole it leaks badly. Listening dialogues and reading texts repeat the exact sentences tested in grammar, fill, reply and order (懂, 完, 着, 次, 不是…吗, 再等她几分钟吧), Q43 and Q56 are the same sentence, Q78/Q79 repeat one passage, and almost every hand-writing word is printed somewhere else in the paper. Some grammar distractors use untaught characters (地, 跟), which makes them easy to rule out.
papers.final: All 15 lessons appear, but lessons 7-8 are thin outside listening and reading. The paper is long enough to be a real final, but it reuses the same few textbook dialogues across listening, reply, text, grammar and order, so a careful student can harvest perhaps twenty answers from other questions. Several order items accept a second word order, several reply items have a second acceptable reply, and the hand-writing section is mostly copyable from printed text elsewhere in the paper.

rules: One source exchange per paper: once a sentence or dialogue (or its core clause) is used anywhere (heard audio, judge or text passage, reply prompt or option, English sentence option), exclude it and its near-copies from every other part (fill, blank, order, reply, dialog, text).
A hand-writing word must not appear in Chinese characters anywhere else in the paper (stems, options, passages), and a word used in pick/meaning must not also be the hand word.
For order items, reject or accept-both when a time word (今天/明天/昨天/每天/这几天) can stand before or after the subject, when 可能 or 因为-clauses can move, and for symmetric 'A离B很远/近' sentences.

Grammar and fill distractors must use only characters already taught at the question's lesson (no 'new' pinyin on a distractor), must be the same word class as the answer, and must not be numbers or nouns in a function-word slot.

Keep a never-together list for near-synonyms that both fit: 更/还 (even more), 好吗/是吗 (tag), 已经/就, 大家/中午 before 好, and check each reply distractor is not itself a natural reply ('我不想吃了', '左边那个', '可以，但是…').
Test each grammar point at most once per paper (有点儿, 因为, 着, 过), never reuse one reply option set for two questions, and never ask the same comprehension question of two passages.
Never use another question's answer sentence as an English distractor, and avoid passages in one paper that state contradictory facts (西瓜 3.5 vs 2.5 yuan, 丈夫 vs 妻子 cooks better).
Show a reading passage once with all its questions instead of printing it twice, and give yes/no questions only Yes / No / We don't know options.
